senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.; also in Chald. diction) liberal, benevolent, indulgent.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 102b:6">Snh. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>ו׳ … היה</he> was very liberal (supporting scholars).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:6:5">Y. Sot. V, end, 20ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 1:1">Job I, 1</cite>) <he>ו׳ היה</he> he (Job) was liberal; <he>ומאן דלית הוא ו׳ וכ׳</he> but if one is not liberal, may he not be virtuous (shunning evil)?; but it means forgiving &c., v. <cite ref="F00115"><he>וָתַר</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:2">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, beg. <he>תהא ו׳ בתוך וכ׳</he> be lenient in thy house (be not angry when anything gets broken &c.).
Y. Gitt. IV, 45ᶜ bot. אילולי דאנא ו׳ if I were not lenient.—Esp. lax in the practice of justice.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 50a:23">B. Kam. 50ᵃ</cite>; Y. Bets. II, end, 62ᵇ, a. fr., v. preced.—Pl. <he>וַתְּרָנִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:13">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> [read:] <he>בביתו … ו׳ היו</he> in the house of Abraham they were kind-hearted.—Fem. <he>וַתְּרָנִית</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:1:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, beg. 39ᵃ</cite> (they said) <he>ע״ז ו׳ היא</he> the heathen deity is benevolent (entertaining the worshippers).
